description: Inside the training ranges but at COMBINATIONS training is very unlikely to have drawn: every axis simultaneously in the outer quintile. Separates generalisation from memorisation -- with 8 axes, uniform sampling puts about 0.2^8 = 2.6e-6 of its mass here, so 4096 envs x 40000 iterations still never sees it.
sampling: uniform within each axis' outer quintile, corners included
